claim: In the awsvpc network mode the ECS task is allocated its own elastic network interface and a primary private IPv4 or IPv6 address, which gives the task the same networking properties as Amazon EC2 instances.
question: What does the awsvpc network mode give an ECS task?

values.display: allocated its own elastic network interface (ENI)
same networking properties as Amazon EC2 instances

qualifiers.scope: Amazon ECS tasks on Amazon EC2
qualifiers.condition: Linux and Windows containers on EC2
